overviews.title: Distance Engineering Diploma Courses in India 2026: Fees, Admission, Courses, Placements
overviews.intro: There are about 100 plus distance Engineering diploma courses in India. Of these , 86 colleges are private and 14 colleges are owned by government organisations. Students can get admission after passing Class 12 boards. Some of the popular distance Engineering colleges in India include IIMT Studies Ghaziabad, Yashwantrao Chavan Maharashtra Open University, IIMT Studies Pune, IIMT Studies Ahmedabad, Wisdom School of Management for Distance Education, IIMT Studies Nashik and many others.

sections.heading: Distance Engineering Diploma Colleges in India: Highlights 2024

content.text: Distance BTech/BE course is for students who are looking for the convenience of remote BTech/BE studies in India. Distance BTech/BE course is a UG academic degree with a duration of two to four years . Some universities offer Distance/Part-time BTech/BE courses that combine online lectures with on-campus lab sessions and exams.

sections.heading: Distance Engineering Diploma Colleges in India: Admissions 2024

content.text: The general eligibility for admission to distance Engineering diploma colleges in India are mentioned below -

items: Pass Class 12 with at least 50% marks with Physics , Chemistry and Math as core subjects.
Individuals who hold a 3-year engineering diploma can also apply for distance engineering diploma programs.
